summary: Iteration 33: final targeted retest of the shipped fix in responsive.css. Only the shipped CSS was tested; no CSS was injected. The script /app/tests/iter33_final.py reuses the handler, measure function and PROBE from iter32_contact_scroll.py. Saved page data was replayed from fixtures, and every non-GET request was aborted. The only blocked request was POST /api/auth/refresh. No contact POST was sent. No app files or data were changed. RESULTS. (1) Production-shape Connect card, at 1024, 1280 and 1920: no inner scrollbar. Inner height equals content height (871, 907 and 941px). overflow-y is visible, min-height is 825px, margin-bottom is 94px, and the translate(2px, 94px) move is kept. Widths of 920, 1158 and 1279px are unchanged. Both columns are preserved (374/374, 476/476 and 532/532px). The card ends 51, 64 and 72px above the footer, so it no longer overlaps it. The Send message button can be clicked after scrolling the page only (the button itself is the element at its centre point; the card's own scroll stays at 0). The results match the iter32 scoped candidate exactly. (2) Validation: clicking Send on the empty form shows 3 field errors and no request is sent. The card grows 69-91px on desktop and 126px on phone. It still has no inner scrollbar, and the gap above the footer stays the same. Confirmed by screenshot at 1280. (3) Phone at 390 (production data): page height is 1772 as expected, margin-bottom is 0, and there is no extra 94px gap. (4) Preview Connect (no saved card size) is unchanged: page height 1416 at 1280 and 1805 at 390. (5) Home Field Notes: the text overlap is now 0px² at 1024 (was 3882) and at 1080 (was 2421). There are still three cards across. The heading and the featured item stay side by side in two columns (619/301px at 1024). The desktop menu is horizontal and on one row (top 30px); the mobile menu button is hidden. At 1280 the layout is identical to before the fix. (6) Editor geometry, checked in the browser only by adding the class (no login): adding body.live-editing switches the card back to the saved height of 825px, overflow-y auto, min-height 0 and margin-bottom 0, with the same transform and width. The editor is not affected. The editor canvas scrollbar was not tested, as agreed.
critical_code_review_comments: The responsive.css top block matches the validated iter32 scoped candidate. The desktop-only min-height and margin-bottom are correctly limited to (min-width: 961px) and (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine), so phones and touch screens get no extra gap.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (9/9 viewport cases plus validation and the editor class check)
